tweets.text: Just discovered this amazing TypeScript pattern for handling async errors. Using discriminated unions with Result types makes error handling so much cleaner. No more try/catch everywhere!
Hot take: Effect-TS is the future of TypeScript error handling. Once you go functional, you never go back. The type safety is incredible.

Thread: Why I switched from Zod to Valibot for TypeScript validation 🧵

1. Bundle size is 10x smaller
2. Same type inference
3. Tree-shakeable by default
PSA: TypeScript 5.8 just dropped with major improvements to type narrowing. The new control flow analysis catches so many edge cases that used to slip through. Upgrade now!
Controversial opinion: You don't need a state management library in 2026. React's built-in hooks + URL state + TanStack Query covers 95% of use cases. Fight me.
